EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a typical aliphatic CH stretching pattern with multiple bands at 2862–2943 cm⁻¹ and a strong CH2 scissoring band at 1441 cm⁻¹ (consistent with GFQ-003). The series of weaker bands at 2677–2787 cm⁻¹ is consistent with overtone/combination bands (Fermi resonance) with the 1441 cm⁻¹ mode (SPC-002). Strong C–O related bands appear at 1040, 1066, 1101, 1126, and 1155 cm⁻¹, and characteristic polyol skeletal modes near 856 and 770 cm⁻¹ are present. A broad, weak OH stretching feature near 3144 cm⁻¹ fits hydrogen-bonded polyols. This pattern closely matches glycerol-type Raman fingerprints, favoring OCC(CO)CO over amine- or C–F-containing candidates.
